# 佛說花聚陀羅尼呪經

**ID:** T1358
**Volume:** T21
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 317–420
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1358

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle anonymous translation, the colophon "失譯人名今附東晉錄" — "translator's name lost, now appended to the Eastern-Jìn catalog". Conventional dating bracket: Eastern Jìn 東晉 (317–420). The Taishō editors mark the parallel "[Nos. 1356, 1357, 1359]" — paired with [KR6j0586](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0586) ([支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) Zhīqiān), [KR6j0587](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0587) (anonymous, *Shīzǐ Fènxùn púsà*-frame), and [KR6j0589](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0589) (Sòng, [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Shīhù).

**Abstract**

The frame is once again the Lake-Anavatapta dragon-king palace setting; the bodhisattva-interlocutor is *Shīzǐ Fènxùn* 師子奮迅, the same as in [KR6j0587](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0587) (and not — as in [KR6j0586](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0586) — *Shīzǐ wēi*). The merit-of-offering analysis is essentially identical, ending in a long *anumodana*-style passage: even the gift of one flower, one lamp, one ball of clay applied before a Buddha-image; one bronze coin given for the repair of a Buddha-image; one handful of water sprinkled on a *stūpa*-floor — by these, *aṣṭa-samaya*-rebirths and low-caste birth are averted for kalpas innumerable. The Buddha then pronounces the *Flower-Heap* dhāraṇī. The ritual prescription specifies recitation in months 2, 3 and 8 (rather than 3, 4 and 9 as in [KR6j0586](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0586)) on the bright-fortnight 8th–15th, with vision of the Buddha on the *lotus-throne* at the conclusion; multiple seven-day periods are permitted if the first does not produce the vision.

The differences in monthly schedule and in the bodhisattva-interlocutor's gloss of his own name distinguish [KR6j0588](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0588) from [KR6j0587](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0587) — the two are *not* simply duplicate copies — and indicate two genuinely distinct translation events. Nanjio N0383.
